newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes unchanged in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes unchanged in active trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended unchanged against the U.S. dollar on Saturday due to the absence of significant market-moving factors, dealers said.
The local dollar hovered in a narrow range trade to finish at T$27.435, unchanged from Friday's close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$110 million.

Dealers saw a slightly uptrend for the local unit next week as exporters were expected to continue recent U.S. dollar sales to meet new year money demand. "The Taiwan dollar will remain firm before the Chinese lunar new year holidays," said one dealer.
A range of T$27.40-45 was seen for next week.
